goals: Readiness at least 3 and an intact Spear
reason: I am Daro, and I intend to make military service purchase something lasting. Joint Navigation gives us a real voice over transport; military autonomy prevents the army becoming somebody else's expendable instrument. I will trade concessions where they buy dependable passage or autonomy, but a vague promise to consider our needs is insufficient. The opening strength can support an actual Campaign, so wasting this month on inaction is unattractive. I accept civilian costs when they secure durable military strength, while keeping Communities above collapse. Guild upkeep and our protection can form a genuine exchange. I will judge constitutional bargains by delivered service, not flattering language.
